newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 industrial growth to remain double digit.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 industrial growth to remain double digit.

text.p: India's industrial growth will remain above double digits by the the end of the 1996/97 (April-March) financial year, Industry Secretary N. Mohanty said on Thursday.
"My assessment is thyat it will remain double-digit by the end of this year, 1996/97," he said on Doordashan, the state-run television channel.
Mohanty said softening interest rates, good agricultural sector growth and easing infrastructure problems will help industrial growth stay above 10 percent.

But asked whether growth would be below the government's targetted 12 percent he said, "One cannot be so sure at this stage. We are still targetting at 12 percent...it will be around that, definitely a double digit figure."
